rules.approval: each entry needs approved_by (not the owner) and approved_at before the release gate accepts it

entries.title: Named technical lead, security contact, SRE on-call, backup owner, service-catalog/pager registration are vacant
entries.risk: Critical: no accountable escalation path during incidents
entries.compensating_control: OWNERSHIP.json + RACI defined; release gate fails closed while roles are vacant
entries.remediation: Fill OWNERSHIP.json and CODEOWNERS with real people/teams; register in service catalog

entries.title: ADR-0001/0002 remain Proposed (no independent approver)
entries.compensating_control: ADR-0002 records the selected 4.3 technologies and rejected alternatives; gate blocks
entries.remediation: Architecture/security/ops review + sign-off recorded in docs/ADR-*.md

entries.title: Cross-node transport is the pk06-rpc/1 wRPC *profile*, not wire-compatible upstream wRPC
entries.risk: Interop with third-party wRPC peers not possible
entries.compensating_control: Same SPI, mutual HMAC auth, mTLS, manifests, deadlines; version negotiation refuses unknown peers
entries.remediation: Bind a pinned wRPC implementation behind TransportAdapter and run tests/test_transports against it

entries.title: RDMA/kernel-bypass data path not shipped (probe only)
entries.compensating_control: Selector records explicit fallback to network-rpc; never silently claims RDMA
entries.remediation: Implement verbs/UCX adapter on RDMA-capable CI hardware

entries.title: GAP-13 integration exercised against in-repo ReferencePolicyService fixture only
entries.compensating_control: PolicyClient verifies signatures, protocol version, anti-downgrade serial and max age; fails closed
entries.remediation: Point PolicyClient at the real GAP-13 endpoint in a staging suite

entries.title: GAP-14 integration exercised against fixture only
entries.risk: Gravity hints from real manager untested
entries.compensating_control: Hints must be signed and request-bound; advisory only, cannot override residency
entries.remediation: Staging suite against real GAP-14

entries.title: PLN-03 hand-off exercised against ReferenceRuntime only
entries.compensating_control: Hand-off retried under bounded policy; failure releases capacity and journals failed
entries.remediation: Staging suite against real PLN-03

entries.title: pk_core certification framework unavailable; 3 conformance tests skip
entries.compensating_control: Standalone evidence dossier + release gate (tools/) produce machine-readable evidence; skip is the only permitted skip and is listed here
entries.remediation: Vendor or pin pk_core with a deterministic acquisition path; remove this waiver

entries.title: Original MASTER.md source artifact is absent
entries.compensating_control: README no longer claims it; not synthesized
entries.remediation: Restore from authoritative source only

entries.title: No LICENSE selected
entries.compensating_control: pyproject license unset; release gate blocks; package marked Private :: Do Not Upload
entries.remediation: Owner/legal selects license; add LICENSE (+NOTICE if needed)

entries.title: OS-level sandboxing (seccomp/landlock/container profile) and hostile-tenant process isolation are deployment controls, not shipped
entries.risk: Adapter compromise could exceed its Grant at OS level
entries.compensating_control: In-process AuthorityGuard checks every privileged action; tenant-namespaced shm; per-tenant quotas
entries.remediation: Ship container/seccomp/landlock profiles and escape tests in the deployment repo

entries.title: Production KMS/HSM key custody not bound (KeyProvider SPI only); at-rest encryption not applied to journal/audit (they hold no payload bytes)
entries.compensating_control: Rotation/verify-only/revocation/expiry/outage fail-closed implemented and tested; payload never persisted
entries.remediation: Bind KeyProvider to KMS/HSM; encrypt journal volume at rest

entries.title: Edge power/thermal evidence unavailable (no RAPL/thermal zones in CI sandbox)
entries.compensating_control: bench/perf.py collects RAPL/thermal where exposed
entries.remediation: Run bench on representative far-edge hardware and retain results

entries.title: Compatibility matrix executed on one CPU arch / Python / Linux only
entries.compensating_control: CI matrix defined for py3.10-3.13 x86_64/arm64; hypervisor/provider rows pending
entries.remediation: Run CI matrix and record results in COMPATIBILITY.md

entries.title: Fleet-scale and multi-hour soak not executed; CI runs short soak (PK06_SOAK_SECONDS)
entries.compensating_control: Bounded-state assertions in soak test; configurable duration
entries.remediation: Nightly 8h soak + fleet test on staging

entries.title: Dashboards/alerts are checked-in definitions, not deployed/validated against a live stack
entries.compensating_control: Rules reviewed; metrics names covered by tests
entries.remediation: Deploy to monitoring stack; fire-drill each alert

entries.title: Release signing uses SHA-256 + optional HMAC; no Sigstore/SLSA provenance
entries.compensating_control: tools/evidence.py + SHA256SUMS; SBOM generated
entries.remediation: Adopt Sigstore/SLSA in CI

entries.title: In-process adapter is a Component-Model-style interface binding, not a wasmtime/WIT runtime
entries.compensating_control: Versioned interface string enforced; zero network authority
entries.remediation: Bind wasmtime component runtime behind InProcessAdapter

entries.title: Vulnerability scanner (pip-audit/OSV) not runnable in offline audit environment
entries.compensating_control: Runtime has zero third-party dependencies (SBOM)
entries.remediation: CI job runs pip-audit/OSV scan on every build

entries.title: Admission throughput collapses from ~89k/s (1 thread) to ~27k/s (2-32 threads): single RLock + GIL contention
entries.compensating_control: Capacity model documents saturation at N=1; scale by sharding planes
entries.remediation: Shard DataPlane by tenant group or move admission to a lock-free/process-per-core design

entries.title: service.submit cyclomatic complexity above default 10 (limit raised to 25)
entries.compensating_control: Covered by 30+ service tests
entries.remediation: Split into admission/move/failover stages

entries.title: Fencing lease is file-backed (single host); fleet deployments need etcd/Consul/ZooKeeper lease
entries.risk: Split-brain across hosts not prevented by file lease
entries.compensating_control: Epoch fencing semantics implemented and tested; lease SPI is small
entries.remediation: Implement FencingLease over the fleet coordination service

entries.title: Deprecated: PK_DATA_PLANE_HEALTH/1 (superseded by /2 from GovernedDataPlane.health)
entries.compensating_control: /1 still emitted by DataPlane.health()
entries.remediation: Remove /1 no earlier than 5.0.0
